I based this on the type declarations you provided, not on running the library, so treat it as an inference. `attachControl` takes `scene` as optional, and the camera exposes `inertia*Offset` fields, which suggests input writes to those offsets and something applied per frame moves `alpha`, `beta`, and `radius`. Without a scene, that per-frame step is probably never registered, so none of the three inputs should change the camera. I could not confirm this from the declarations alone, so QA should check it on the real page before relying on it.
